title: Character
description: Character bible (production/characters/<CHAR_ID>/character.yaml): identity, canonical physical description, and the registry of reference assets used for identity-consistent generation.

id.description: Base character ID without version suffix (e.g. CHAR_MARA).

name.description: Character's full name as used in the script.

role.description: Narrative function; drives how much reference coverage the character needs.

description.description: Canonical physical description. Prompts are compiled from these fields; never contradict them.

summary.description: One-paragraph canonical appearance, written as a generation-ready description.

distinguishing_features.description: Scars, marks, jewelry — features that must survive every generation.

personality.description: Temperament and behavior; informs blocking and performance direction.

voice.description: Speech quality and cadence; used by dialogue/audio generation.

arc.description: How the character changes across the story.

first_appearance.description: Scene where the character first appears.

wardrobe_file.description: Relative path to this character's wardrobe.yaml (wardrobe.schema.json).

references.description: Registry of reference assets for this character. Approved masters are immutable; supersede with a new _V## version.

path.description: Path to the image, relative to this character's directory.

status.description: Approval gate. Only approved assets may be cited as required references.
